title: MpiAnySwitch selects the Nth CONNECTED input, not any_N: an unwired slot runs the wrong branch
description: Noticed on MPI-936 bench (2026-10-08): MpiAnySwitch/MpiAnySwitch10 (ComfyUi-MpiNodes switches.py) pick the Nth connected input, so with any_3 unwired 'inpaint' ran detail, 'detail' ran upscale and 'upscale' ran off the end and saved nothing. Same-day scan of all 62 switches in the shipped API graphs (comfy_workflows/ + workflow_generation/): none gapped, so no user impact today. Fix: select by input name (node change via /mpi-nodes-sync: committed, pushed, pinned) or at least a doc line for workflow authors. Umbrella MPI-1064.
